description: Defines the class 'ru_dummy_sector' which implements a dummy sector for a radio unit (RU) in a 3GPP-like system. It handles downlink data, uplink requests, PRACH occasions, manages request buffers, and tracks metrics related to requests and late arrivals.

classes.name: ru_dummy_sector
classes.description: Implements a dummy radio unit sector handling downlink, uplink, and PRACH requests, with request buffering, late request detection, and metrics collection.

methods.name: handle_dl_data
methods.description: Handles incoming downlink data requests, updates request buffer, and logs late requests.

methods.name: handle_prach_occasion
methods.description: Handles PRACH occasion requests, updates buffer, and logs late requests.

methods.name: handle_new_uplink_slot
methods.description: Handles new uplink slot requests, updates buffer, and logs late requests.

methods.name: new_slot_boundary
methods.description: Processes requests at slot boundary, checks for late requests, and triggers notifications.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the dummy RU sector processing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the dummy RU sector processing.

methods.name: collect_metrics
methods.description: Collects current metrics related to requests and late arrivals.
